# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified browser distribution, served locally and embedded in QSObook. No CDN or npm installation is required at runtime. Leaflet is used only by the optional contact map. It is the stable release listed on the [official download page](https://leafletjs.com/download.html), with [upstream source](https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4).

Files were downloaded from `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/` and the package's `LICENSE`. JavaScript and CSS were checked against the SHA-256 integrity values published by Leaflet:

- `leaflet.js`: `20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- `leaflet.css`: `p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`

The BSD-2-Clause [license](LICENSE) is retained verbatim and included in the application's third-party notices. This dependency does not change the application's AGPL license. Review upstream changes, licensing, integrity and browser/ARM64 build checks before replacing it.
